purpose: Define AnalyzerRegistry and pipeline::search, the core of `monokl search`: query to fully ranked, deduplicated, uncapped blocks with counts and diagnostics, per docs/spec/01-core-architecture.md Section 20 stages 1-7 and 05 sections 18-20. Budgeting is a separate stage.
scope: crates/monokl/src/analysis/registry.rs and crates/monokl/src/pipeline/mod.rs. Works against the LanguageAnalyzer trait only; tests use in-test stand-in analyzers.
non_goals: Any real analyzer (TsAnalyzer), budgets, token counting, truncation markers, serde on result types, printing.
Registry construction from workspace options and config hashes; AnalyzerRegistry::new takes ready analyzers.
A caller-visible max_files option: the file ceiling is text_search::DEFAULT_MAX_FILES.
BM25 contribution of regex terms: regex terms add matched lines and matched_keywords but no BM25 query terms.
Diagnostic wire shapes; the output layer owns them.

api_surface.name: AnalyzerRegistry
api_surface.signature: pub struct AnalyzerRegistry; impl AnalyzerRegistry { pub fn new(analyzers: Vec<Arc<dyn LanguageAnalyzer>>) -> Self; pub fn analyzer_for(&self, path: &Utf8Path) -> Option<&dyn LanguageAnalyzer>; pub fn supports_language(&self, path: &Utf8Path, languages: &[LanguageId]) -> bool }
api_surface.description: Ordered analyzers; the first whose supports(path) is true owns the path.

api_surface.name: search
api_surface.description: Runs language filter, query parse, text search, boolean evaluation, block retrieval, ranking and dedup.
error_conditions: MonoklError::Io or NonUtf8Path when root cannot be canonicalized
MonoklError::RegexBuild when any term, excluded ones included, is an invalid regex
MonoklError::Walk when root is not a listable directory

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AnalyzerRegistry::analyzer_for returns the first registered analyzer whose supports(path) is true, None when none is, and supports_language is true only when that analyzer's language_for(path) is in the given list.

A request with a language other than TypeScript or JavaScript returns no blocks, files_total 0 and one Skipped diagnostic whose message is "language {language:?} not supported in v1; only TypeScript/JavaScript"; an empty query, and an exact query that is only whitespace, return an empty result with no diagnostics.
A query of only excluded terms returns an empty result with exactly one Skipped diagnostic saying the query has no positive terms.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Resolves open question #21: a silent empty result is indistinguishable from no match.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Boolean evaluation: a file with a line matching an excluded term yields no blocks, even when the excluded term is in a file past the text-search file ceiling; a file missing a required term in every hit line yields none; optional terms alone need only one match. Terms match case-insensitively.
With exact set, the whole query text, operators and quotes included, is one escaped literal optional term.

Only blocks whose line range contains a hit line are kept; matched_lines holds the hit lines inside the block in ascending order and matched_keywords the unescaped text (or regex source) of each non-excluded term matching one of them, in query order.

Blocks are ranked with BM25 query terms taken from tokens::tokenize of each non-excluded literal term, then deduplicated; ranks are 1-based and contiguous, the result is uncapped, and two runs over the same tree give equal results.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: rank_blocks takes lowercase tokens, so literals are tokenized and regex terms contribute none.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: files_total and ceiling_hit are the text search's values. Each unreadable path becomes one Skipped diagnostic with that path; non_utf8_paths and walk_errors_without_path above zero each become one diagnostic stating the count.

A file no registered analyzer supports yields no blocks and no diagnostic; a source read failure yields one Skipped diagnostic with the path; an analyzer error yields one Skipped diagnostic with the path; had_parse_errors yields one Degraded diagnostic with the path and the blocks are still used.
An invalid regex in any term, positive or excluded, fails the whole search with MonoklError::RegexBuild before any file is read; a nonexistent root fails with MonoklError::Io.

linked_research: docs/spec/01-core-architecture.md Section 20; docs/spec/03-multi-language-platform.md section 3; docs/architecture/query-and-ranking.md; docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md sections 18-20; SPEC-013 non_goals. No requirement@1 REQ-016 exists.
